summary: Round 39 — Review reply templates, bad-review notifications, and A2HS tracking/stats. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases passed covering templates GET/PUT (default 5 items, persist new, empty→defaults fallback), bad-review counts/filter/badges/dashboard totals, PATCH handled & reply both move items out of bad list and are reversible, /api/track event whitelist (400 on unknown, 200 on all 5 known events, iOS UA → platform=ios), /api/admin/a2hs/stats shape (tip_shown/tip_open/tip_close/tip_ctr/dialog_open/pwa_launch/by_platform/by_source/series×30), tip_ctr == round(open/shown*100,1), admin-token guard. Admin UI E2E (1920×1080, admin+clerk_test@shop.com + TOTP): sidebar admin-nav-badge-reviews='1', todo-bad-reviews card shown on dashboard-admin and navigates to review-bad-banner, review-stat-bad toggles filter on/off, review-bad-flag-{id} + review-handled-{id} rendered on the 1★ row, reply dialog opens with 5 review-tpl-* chips, click chip fills review-tpl-* text into review-reply-input exactly, review-tpl-manage opens review-tpl-form with 5 defaults, review-tpl-add + fill + review-tpl-save persists and re-opening shows the new entry, review-tpl-remove-{i} + save restores. A2HS stats card renders a2hs-stat-shown/open/ctr/dialog/launch and reacts to dash-range-7/30/90. Mobile iPhone UA E2E (390×844, localStorage a2hs_tip_until cleared): a2hs-tip appeared after ~5s and fired POST /api/track event=a2hs_tip_shown, tip-open fired a2hs_tip_open + a2hs_dialog_open(source=tip), drawer-a2hs fired a2hs_dialog_open(source=drawer). Clean-up: templates restored (empty save → GET returns defaults), test bad reviews deleted, no leftover TEST_ data.

integration_issues.issue: Each dialog-open interaction fires 2 POST /api/track events (duplicate a2hs_dialog_open). Visible in both tip-open and drawer-a2hs paths. Likely React 18 StrictMode double-effect in dev build; will inflate tip_open/dialog_open/pwa_launch counts in /api/admin/a2hs/stats and tip_ctr math. Consider firing track() outside useEffect or guarding with a ref so counts stay accurate in dev (prod should be fine without StrictMode).

issues: React hydration warning persists from iter_38: <span> inside <option>. Caused by dev wrapper injecting x-source <span style={display:'contents'}> into static <option> array children in ReviewsAdmin.jsx line ~104. Non-blocking (dev-only), but still noisy.

action_items: (Optional) Debounce track() calls or move out of effect to avoid double-firing under React StrictMode (will double-count a2hs stats in preview).
(Carryover from iter_38) Hunt down the admin <option> hydration warning (ReviewsAdmin rating select array).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py BAD_REVIEW_COND reused for /admin/badges, /admin/reviews counts.bad, /admin/reviews?bad=1 filter and admin_api.dashboard totals.bad_reviews — single source of truth, good.

admin_save_review_templates trims items, drops empties, caps at 30 — safe. Empty list falls back to defaults on GET via `(doc or {}).get('items') or DEFAULT_REPLY_TEMPLATES` — intentional and documented.
ReviewPatch.handled: Optional[bool] correctly treated as patch-only field (not stripped like reply). admin_patch_review also sets replied_at='' when reply cleared — bad list recomputes correctly.
/api/track enforces TRACK_EVENTS whitelist and truncates source[:40]/path[:120] — guard against abuse. platform detection iPhone|iPad|iPod → ios OK.
a2hs/stats uses $substr on created_at (ISO string) for date grouping — works because now_iso() emits 'YYYY-MM-DD…'. Fine but relies on string-sortable UTC timestamps; document it.
DashboardAdmin uses sessionStorage 'reviews_preset'='bad' to cross-page communicate — ReviewsAdmin reads it on mount; works but a URL query param would be more robust for deep-linking.
A2HSTip reads navigator at module scope and track() fires inside useEffect without a guard; React 18 StrictMode will cause 2× dispatch — observed in preview.
